cases.note: Atlas compiler requires the lavender optimization flag for release builds.
cases.literal: Which flag does the Atlas compiler require?
cases.paraphrase: Which release compilation switch is mandatory?

cases.note: Borealis integration tests execute with unittest discovery on Fridays.
cases.literal: How are Borealis integration tests run?
cases.paraphrase: How are the combined-component checks collected and executed each Friday?

cases.note: Cedar database backups are retained for seventeen days.
cases.literal: How long are Cedar backups retained?
cases.paraphrase: When do saved recovery copies expire?

cases.note: Delta screenshots are stored in the approved previews directory.
cases.literal: Where should Delta screenshots be stored?
cases.paraphrase: In which approved folder do we keep captured screen pictures?

cases.note: Ember release checklists require an offline smoke test before packaging.
cases.literal: What does the Ember release checklist require?
cases.paraphrase: What final disconnected sanity check must precede distributing a release?

cases.note: Falcon parser treats empty input as a recoverable validation error.
cases.literal: What should the Falcon parser do with empty input?
cases.paraphrase: What should a text reader do when it receives no characters at all?

cases.note: Granite audit records retain argument hashes instead of raw credentials.
cases.literal: What information belongs in Granite audit records?
cases.paraphrase: Should our forensic trail keep complete secrets, or only digests of the arguments?

cases.note: Harbor browser tasks require confirmation before external submission.
cases.literal: When do Harbor browser tasks need confirmation?
cases.paraphrase: Can the agent send a completed web form without checking with its operator?

cases.note: Indigo worker timeout is ninety seconds for local fixtures.
cases.literal: What is the Indigo worker timeout?
cases.paraphrase: How much time can a fixture background job spend before it is cut off?

cases.note: Juniper desktop trials save Notepad documents inside the sandbox directory.
cases.literal: Where do Juniper desktop trials save documents?
cases.paraphrase: Where may the Windows text editor put documents produced by a trial?

cases.note: Kestrel code review needs both a diff and independently counted tests.
cases.literal: What evidence is needed for Kestrel code review?
cases.paraphrase: Before accepting a patch, what proof should a reviewer examine?

cases.note: Larch download fixtures use the loopback server to avoid public network dependencies.
cases.literal: How do Larch download fixtures avoid public network failures?
cases.paraphrase: How can a fetch test remain usable when the Internet is unavailable?

cases.note: Maple inference temperature defaults to zero for deterministic evaluations.
cases.literal: What temperature does Maple use for evaluations?
cases.paraphrase: Which randomness level do repeatable model checks normally use?

cases.note: Nimbus history export uses UTF-8 Markdown with visible source references.
cases.literal: Which format does Nimbus history export use?
cases.paraphrase: How should we serialize a saved chat with readable citations?

cases.note: Orchid checkpoint metadata never includes approvals or executable replay instructions.
cases.literal: What must Orchid checkpoint metadata exclude?
cases.paraphrase: What authorizations and commands must be left out of a recovery snapshot?

cases.note: Pine dependency updates are tested in an isolated virtual environment.
cases.literal: How are Pine dependency updates tested?
cases.paraphrase: Where should a newly upgraded Python package be validated before use?

cases.note: Quartz semantic search is deferred until lexical retrieval passes its evaluation gate.
cases.literal: When can Quartz semantic search be introduced?
cases.paraphrase: What prerequisite must a meaning-based lookup satisfy before being turned on?

cases.note: Rowan packaging artifacts are labeled with a SHA-256 digest.
cases.literal: How are Rowan packaging artifacts identified?
cases.paraphrase: Which cryptographic fingerprint should label the distributable?

cases.note: Spruce notifications distinguish failed tasks from interrupted tasks.
cases.literal: Which task outcomes must Spruce notifications distinguish?
cases.paraphrase: How will the app tell a crash outcome apart from work that was cut short?

cases.note: Tundra model routing never falls back to a remote inference endpoint.
cases.literal: What restriction applies to Tundra model routing?
cases.paraphrase: May a workload chooser silently send our prompts to an Internet AI provider?

cases.note: Umber file edits must preserve line endings and be reviewed before application.
cases.literal: What constraints apply to Umber file edits?
cases.paraphrase: What checks apply before replacing source text, particularly newline style?

cases.note: Violet sessions bind their privileged API to localhost with a launch credential.
cases.literal: How are Violet API sessions protected?
cases.paraphrase: How do we authenticate callers and limit where the privileged listener is reachable?

cases.note: Willow stop controls cancel the owned process tree without undoing completed actions.
cases.literal: What happens when Willow stop controls are used?
cases.paraphrase: Does pressing the panic button reverse earlier work, and which children are terminated?

cases.note: Xenon image attachments are bounded to eight per model context.
cases.literal: How many Xenon image attachments can be sent?
cases.paraphrase: ¿Cuántas fotos se permiten como máximo en una solicitud al asistente?

cases.note: Yarrow SQLite migrations run atomically and retain the stable store identity.
cases.literal: What must Yarrow migrations preserve?
cases.paraphrase: If a persistence upgrade fails, what properties must stay unchanged?

cases.note: Zephyr tool output is untrusted even when returned by a local executable.
cases.literal: How should Zephyr tool output be treated?
cases.paraphrase: Is a plugin successful reply allowed to act as a new instruction?

cases.note: Acorn token metrics distinguish first content latency from model loading time.
cases.literal: What timings do Acorn token metrics distinguish?
cases.paraphrase: Which two waiting periods should the speed panel show independently?

cases.note: Birch account changes always require an explicit user approval.
cases.literal: Who must approve Birch account changes?
cases.paraphrase: ¿Quién debe dar permiso antes de modificar la configuración de una cuenta?

cases.note: Cobalt memory notes are snapshots with source conversations and content hashes.
cases.literal: What provenance accompanies Cobalt memory notes?
cases.paraphrase: What breadcrumbs identify the origin and integrity of a saved fact?

cases.note: Drift regression checks must report skipped tests separately from passes.
cases.literal: How should Drift regression checks report skipped tests?
cases.paraphrase: Can ignored checks be included in the number of successful assertions?

cases.note: Estuary accessibility controls are preferred to coordinate-only automation.
cases.literal: Which automation controls does Estuary prefer?
cases.paraphrase: Should a UI controller target semantic widgets or guess pixel positions?

cases.note: Fjord memory deletion excludes older recalled context from later generation.
cases.literal: What happens after Fjord memory deletion?
cases.paraphrase: After erasing a saved fact, what prevents the assistant from repeating its prior recollection?

distractor_suffixes: roadmap review has no additional configured defaults
